invariants: Evidence levels are assigned per target result rather than per paper
TRACEABLE precedes RERUNNABLE REPLAYED and INDEPENDENTLY_REPRODUCED on the computational axis
External replication or transport is a separate scientific-validation axis
File existence and repository links are not execution evidence
A container tag is not immutable identity without a digest
Code commit and dirty state remain visible
Resolved configuration includes defaults and overrides
Input output data model-weight and environment versions remain distinct
A checksum verifies identity rather than correctness ethics or clinical validity
Seeds do not guarantee deterministic GPU or parallel execution
Tolerance is frozen before observing replay output
Failed and negative runs remain visible
Silent code data environment or tolerance repair is prohibited

Replay execution requires current authorization and a safe workspace
REPLAYED requires execution on identified same inputs and tolerance passage
INDEPENDENTLY_REPRODUCED requires a different operator or team without hidden author state

External evidence does not require prior same-data independent reproduction
Same-input replay does not establish external clinical validity
External-data adaptation is not untouched external validation
Restricted data need not be public to support a controlled replay route
Synthetic fixtures test mechanics rather than reproduce real-data results
Code data weights dependencies and vendor assets retain separate licences
An open repository without a licence does not automatically grant reuse
Mutable repositories are distinct from versioned citable archives
Archive readiness does not upgrade the computational evidence level
Radiology patient exam series reconstruction derived-object and annotation hierarchy remains explicit
Acquisition validity statistical correctness and data-sharing authority remain external
